_meta.category: Indonesia Life Deep Data — Cost of Living, Work, Business, Social, Expat, Economic
_meta.description: Comprehensive data on life in Indonesia: rent, food, transport, utilities, healthcare, education, salaries, freelancing, digital nomad, startup, gig economy, business registration, taxes, e-commerce, social commerce, franchise, marriage, religion, divorce, Gen Z, social media, e-wallet, visa, property, GDP, inflation, crypto, banking, remittance. Focus cities: Bandung, Jakarta, Bali, Surabaya, Yogyakarta.
_meta.sources_summary: BPS (Badan Pusat Statistik), Bank Indonesia (BI), OJK, Katadata, DailySocial, Numbeo, Grab, Gojek, Kemenkeu, Kemnaker, BKPM, IDX, We Are Social / Meltwater, World Bank, Statista, local reporting (Kompas, Tempo, CNBC Indonesia)
